div.div: Build an agent that autonomously plans research questions, retrieves papers, summarises findings, extracts insights, and writes structured research reports.
The solution should help researchers, analysts, and knowledge workers accelerate literature review and synthesis.
Research planning quality, retrieval relevance, citation-awareisation, and coherent synthesis across sources.
